speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long these skin lesions have been present and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: My mom says the bumps have been there for a few weeks, and they don't hurt or itch at all. They just look like little shiny bumps with a tiny dent in the middle. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those "shiny bumps with a tiny dent in the middle" are classic for molluscum contagiosum. DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum contagiosum
